social.author: Joseph Borroto
social.headline: I treat the camera like a client, not a camera. That one shift changed all my content.
social.cta: Here's exactly how I do it →

slides.title: Talk TO one person
slides.body: Not 'hey guys.' One person, one problem. It reads as a real conversation.

slides.title: Say the point in line one
slides.body: If the first sentence doesn't stop the scroll, nothing after it matters.

slides.title: Be yourself on camera
slides.body: The personality is the moat. Nobody can copy how you actually talk.

slides.title: Make every video different
slides.body: Same energy, new angle. The feed should never feel like a rerun.

slides.title: Just get content out
slides.body: Posted beats perfect. Volume is how you find what actually lands.

social.author: Joseph Borroto
social.headline: Stop trying to sound like a 'content creator.' Just be yourself on camera.
social.cta: Here's how I stay myself on camera →

slides.title: Talk how you actually talk
slides.body: The 'script voice' is what makes people scroll. Your real voice keeps them.

slides.title: Your quirks are the brand
slides.body: The weird way you say things is the one thing nobody can copy.

slides.title: Borrow structure, not personality
slides.body: Steal the format from big accounts. Keep your own voice on top of it.

slides.title: Film like you're texting a friend
slides.body: Casual beats polished. People trust a person, not a presenter.

slides.title: The more 'you,' the better it does
slides.body: Every time I loosen up on camera, the content does better.

social.author: Joseph Borroto
social.headline: Most people overthink their content. I just get it out — and that's why mine grows.

slides.title: Posted beats perfect
slides.body: A 'good enough' video that exists beats a perfect one that never goes up.

slides.title: Volume teaches you
slides.body: You learn what works by posting, not by planning. The reps are the lesson.

slides.title: Lower the stakes
slides.body: One post isn't make-or-break. The hundredth one is what compounds.

slides.title: Batch when you can
slides.body: I filmed 12 videos on one trip — a week of content in an afternoon.

slides.title: Consistency compounds
slides.body: The algorithm rewards the person who keeps showing up. Be that person.
